nodes.label: enet channels (reliable / unreliable sequenced)
nodes.rationale: A late input/state packet is useless once newer exists.

nodes.label: Hitstop (presentation only)
nodes.rationale: Simulation and networking keep running; only presentation freezes.

nodes.label: Input budget
nodes.rationale: Prevents speed hacks by sending inputs faster.

nodes.label: Input commands and redundancy
nodes.rationale: Each packet carries last 4 commands so a lost packet costs nothing.

nodes.label: Authoritative 60 tick server
nodes.rationale: Lockstep (Athena) adds full network delay; a duel needs instant movement so client-side prediction is used.

nodes.rationale: Practice with only one player really pauses.
